content: Abhishek Mandloi is a Senior Backend & Big Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience based in Indore, India. Phone: 6265494851 | Email: abhimandloi111@gmail.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/abhishek-mandloi-8412ba1b2.

Professional Summary: Results-driven Backend Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Big Data engineering, specializing in building scalable microservices, high-throughput real-time data streaming pipelines (Apache Kafka, HBase, Hadoop, Gathr), and enterprise Generative AI applications (AWS & Gemini RAG chatbots). Adept at owning end-to-end services in fast-paced Agile environments.
Current Role: Senior Software Engineer at Impetus Technologies (India) Pvt. Ltd. (March 2022 – Present | India).

Key Project - Metatrail Pipeline (Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Hadoop, HBase, Gathr, Klera, Kafka): Researched and delivered optimum solutions for a large-scale social media Big Data problem focused on stream processing, transformation, and scalable storage on HDFS/YARN clusters. Key achievements: 1) Engineered production-grade pipeline on Gathr processing ~650M social media records/day. 2) Owned end-to-end delivery of Java-based business service for HBase data retrieval, improving retrieval performance by 60%. 3) Validated and deployed data pipelines into production with minimal post-deployment issues. 4) Diagnosed and resolved critical bugs and performance bottlenecks.

Key Project - RAG-based Call Center Chatbot (AWS, RAG, Generative AI): Designed and built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot on AWS to automate FAQ handling for call center support, reducing average query resolution time by 70%. Leveraged Google Gemini and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development cycles and improve solution design and code quality.
Programming & Big Data Skills: Core Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, HDFS, YARN, Gathr Platform, Apache Spark.
Tools, IDEs & Version Control: Klera, Gathr, WinSCP, Offset Explorer, IntelliJ IDEA, Windsurf, Git, SVN.
AI Tools: Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, AWS AI Services.

Education Details: 1) Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science from Sage University, Indore (2018–2022). 2) 12th Standard from Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Indore (2017–2018). 3) 10th Standard from Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Indore (2015–2016).
